name: EIP-7702 trading account pays any pancakeV3SwapCallback caller
summary: Trading account 0x0000000005f122fd ran, through its EIP-7702 delegation, the unverified contract 0x02c8095e, whose pancakeV3SwapCallback paid the positive delta in the caller's token0/token1 without checking that the caller is a PancakeSwap V3 pool. The attacker's fake pool reported WBNB for both tokens and called the callback with amount0Delta equal to the account's whole WBNB balance, receiving 28.18 WBNB.
notes: Reset is the account's own type-4 transaction 0x1a16021c, whose authorization moved its designator from 0x4ba640fb (which has no pancakeV3SwapCallback or uniswapV3SwapCallback selector) to 0x02c8095e; the account deployed 0x02c8095e itself in 0xbefaab79. Code runs in the account's frame without a DELEGATECALL, so derive needs the EIP-7702 designator check.

Campaign: every transaction since the delegation that moved tokens out of the account and was not sent by it (transfer-log scan to the current block); none preceded the anchor. The five copycats each called the callback and swept dust worth $0.93 in priced tokens plus unpriced memecoins, left out of the loss.
